status: Declared before computing or inspecting OOB performance from the stored bootstrap fits.
scope: Secondary posthoc functional diagnostic of the existing 1000 whole-scenario bootstrap fits for alpha_10__risk_only. The primary selection process, alpha, menus and assignments remain frozen.
prior_exposure: The full-development menu and internal five-fold outcomes, bootstrap assignment frequencies and target identities are already known. V1 final evaluation was seen earlier in the project. This is not preregistration on unseen development data or a new blind holdout.
index_reconstruction: Exactly rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); samples=rng.integers(0,120,size=(1000,120)). Repeated inbag indices retain their training multiplicities. Unique inbag IDs and OOB complement are recorded separately. No reseeding per replicate.
frozen_decisions: Use each stored assignment and its stored candidate ID, with its menu label; do not choose an OOB oracle, replace a target, rescreen on OOB, or modify a referral.

reconstruction_checks.method: Re-run the unchanged fit_menu on exactly the reconstructed repeated inbag indices; compare stored menu IDs, weights, assignments and per-client chosen candidate IDs.
reconstruction_checks.all_replicates: Require stored replicate identities 0..999 exactly once, assigned target membership in that replicate menu, consistent Review flags, and unique inbag/OOB disjoint partition of IDs1..120.

samples.inbag: Use all 120 repeated inbag indices and their multiplicities, exactly the empirical training distribution.
samples.oob: Use each omitted original scenario once; denominator is replicate-specific.
samples.original120_including_inbag: Frozen-target descriptive performance on all original120 paths; explicitly includes training observations and is not validation.

per_replicate_client_outputs.referrals: Retain all 5000 replicate-client rows and membership denominators. Review rows have NULL candidate and NULL investment outcomes in every sample; no adviser outcome or bill-only fallback is invented.
per_replicate_client_outputs.coverage: Report automatic/referral indicators and counts. OOB investment metrics condition on that replicate-client being automatically assigned; no reassignment after viewing OOB.

summary_policy.primary_aggregation_unit: replicate-client; summarize each client's scalar OOB metrics across automatically assigned replicates, with each replicate equally weighted, plus explicit conditioning counts and OOB denominator distribution.
summary_policy.quantile_method: inverted_cdf empirical generalized inverse; median is the mean of the two middle values when even.
summary_policy.paired_differences: For each automatically assigned replicate-client, report OOB minus inbag mean growth, breach probability, expected excess MDD and CVaR90, then summarize those differences across replicates.
summary_policy.threshold_diagnostics: Report the fraction of automatically assigned replicates with OOB empirical breach proportion > .10; this is descriptive and affected by small/discrete OOB denominators, not a significance test or calibrated confidence.
summary_policy.no_pooled_certificate: Do not treat repeated OOB rows as independent, do not compute a pooled binomial certificate or a new confidence interval for population risk. Different fitted menus and overlapping OOB/training sets prevent such an interpretation.
summary_policy.no_bootstrap_confidence_claim: Across-replicate quantiles describe this empirical resampling procedure; they are not asserted to be calibrated confidence intervals for true risk, weights or growth.

identity_and_role_outputs.complete_menu_recurrence: Exact ordered risk-label candidate tuple equals the full-development menu tuple; also disclose an unordered-set check.
identity_and_role_outputs.client_original_target_recurrence: Fraction of all 1000 replicates with the same chosen target as full development, and conditional fraction among automatic replicates; if original assignment is Review, original-target recurrence is not applicable and original referral recurrence is reported separately.
identity_and_role_outputs.role_movement: Counts of original role versus bootstrap assigned role, jointly with whether A is automatically assigned. These are relative catalogue labels, not inferred preference changes.
identity_and_role_outputs.no_target_search: All results describe existing stored menus and assignments only.

accounting_and_risk.risk_event: MDD - client_L > 1e-12, consistent with the unchanged primary metrics.
accounting_and_risk.severity: Expected excess is zero for numerical equality; CVaR90 includes fractional boundary probability atoms.
accounting_and_risk.cache_validation: Require development IDs1..120 only, cache/metadata hashes, current numerical source hashes and guarded load_paths(...,range(1,121),allow_final=False) development input-array digest. No final-return value is requested or parsed.

provenance: Hash this protocol before performance computation. Record source and input artifact SHA256 before and after execution; abort writing performance outputs if either changes. Record output hashes in a manifest; the manifest cannot hash itself.
prohibited_actions: Changing the primary selector or runner
Calling the repeated OOB observations independent market evidence
